purpose: Local demonstration assets for app-fashion-store. Editorial photos do not depict the RACK sample catalogue.

assets.title: T Shirt
assets.author: funlab117
assets.usage: Active Relaxed Tee throughout rail, collection, close view, bag and favourites. Source reduced from 237938 to 29116 triangles with locked boundaries and normal/UV weighting; matching cotton surfaces merged; presentation rotation removed; fitted to the rail. Cotton roughness/sheen and Chalk/Ink tints added. chalk.png and ink.png are renders of the assembled product.

assets.title: Wooden hanger from CC0 - Shirt On Hanger
assets.author: plaggy
assets.usage: Shared wooden hanger for all twelve products. Extracted separately so the archived CHEESE shirt geometry and textures do not load. Original shape, UVs and three PBR images retained; fitted per collar at runtime.

assets.title: Clothes
assets.author: Naira
assets.usage: Four actual sculpted garments used throughout the rail, style collections, close view and menus. Extracted from one source collection, uniformly scaled and fitted to the rail. Original geometry, UVs and all 27 PBR images retained across the four exports. Displayed original hanger meshes are hidden and all four garments use the shared wooden hanger by plaggy. The archived GLBs preserve the original geometry and maps. original.png files are renders of each same GLB.

assets.title: CC0 - Shirt On Hanger
assets.author: plaggy
assets.usage: Archived original Studio Tee/CHEESE sample; no longer displayed or requested by the active catalogue. The wooden hanger has been extracted as a separate GLB.
